title: 听力挑战 · 聊人生经历

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Have you ever been to London for work?

grammar.name: 现在完成时 have been to
grammar.note: have been to 表示'去过某地',强调经历,常与 ever 连用。

options.text: Yes, I have visited it twice.
options.feedback: 用现在完成时回应经历类问题,表达准确。

options.text: Yes, I will go there tomorrow.
options.feedback: will 表将来计划,与'去过'的经历问题不符。

options.text: No, I am not feeling well.
options.feedback: 说的是身体状况,没有回答是否去过。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: How long have you been studying English here?
rounds.lineCn: 你在这里学英语多久了?

grammar.name: 现在完成进行时
grammar.note: have been doing 表示从过去持续到现在的动作,常与 how long 搭配。

options.text: I have studied it for five years.
options.feedback: 用现在完成时加 for 时间段,回答持续时间。
只说了此刻在学什么,没有回答学了多久。
过去时说的是昨晚,没有说明持续时间。

rounds.speaker: 邻居
rounds.line: Have you tried the new coffee shop near us?
rounds.lineCn: 你尝过我们附近那家新咖啡馆吗?

grammar.name: 现在完成时表经验
grammar.note: have tried 表示'已经试过',询问对方是否有过该经历。

options.text: Yes, I have tried their caramel latte.
options.feedback: 用现在完成时回应,具体说明试过的东西。

options.text: Yes, I like coffee very much.
options.feedback: 只说喜欢咖啡,没有回答是否试过那家店。

options.text: No, I am drinking tea now.
options.feedback: 现在喝什么不代表试过那家咖啡馆。
